entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • FromBase64Transform.TransformFinalBlock clears state inconsistently #122809
  • FromBase64Transform asserts when destination buffer is too small #122807
  • File: low-level API for creating anonymous pipe #122806
    11.0.0
  • FromBase64Transform incorrectly rents from CryptoPool (ArrayPool) #122804
  • File: low-level APIs for opening null device #122803
    11.0.0
  • Console: low-level APIs for getting STD IN/OUT/ERR handles #122802
    11.0.0
  • [area-Tools-ILLink]: The given key 'Maui.Health.Services.HealthService/<WriteHealthData>d__17`1' was not present in the dictionary #122800
  • Critical SIGABRT crash in .NET 10 Android (ARM64) – Assertion jit-info.c:918 (!ji->async) #122797
  • IOptions: Inconsistent object creation for root vs nested configuration #122796

Closed

  • XmlReader error when importing a large unformatted file (IXmlLineInfo.LinePosition incorrect) #54331
  • [wasm] Trailer headers not implemented #54156
  • 'Unsafe.Unbox' works differently from the document #122782
  • Dispose filehandle in background thread on Windows? #50910
  • [Proposal] Create view handle from MemoryMappedFile instance #52161
  • System.IO.Directory.EnumerateFiles: inconsistent semantics of passing an empty-string search pattern, varies by overload #52308
  • Failed to build "CoreCLR component". #53805

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix FromBase64Transform incorrectly renting from CryptoPool #122805
    area-System.Security
  • [browser][coreCLR] JS modules consistency via gitHash #122801
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • [browser][coreCLR] detect browser features and fail fast #122799
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • [browser][coreCLR] fix incremental build #122798
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Rename AsyncSafeThreadMap to SignalSafeThreadMap #122794
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Consolidate runtime helpers (X86Base, Interlocked, Buffer) across CoreCLR and NativeAOT #122791
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr

Merged

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #122581
    area-codeflow
  • [System.DirectoryServices] Fixed possible NRE in SAMStoreCtx.cs #118123
    area-System.DirectoryServices, community-contribution
  • Consolidate classlibnative directory into vm #122780
  • Support ICU v78 changes including IDN and Japanese Meiji era start date #122480
    area-System.Globalization, breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created, 11.0.0

Updated

  • [WIP] Remove Environment.IsWindows8OrAbove property and its references #122810
  • Refactor NativeAOT helpers to align with CoreCLR patterns #121158
    needs-area-label
  • [release/8.0][mono] Fix memory leak #122787
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Fix #84344 to ensure sufficient stack by calling RuntimeHelpers.EnsureSufficientExecutionStack() #122761
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • Fix IndexOutOfRangeException in ILVerify for invalid exception handler offsets #122056
    blocked, area-Tools-ILVerification
  • Add packed SearchValues<string> specialization for two strings #122749
    area-System.Runtime
  • Runtime-async Exception.ToString() #122722
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr, area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
